decisions.reason: As a core adjustable cardboard display closely aligned with our announced innovation path and past launch commitments, we would keep supporting it and read any softness as temporary rather than abandon it now.

Because this pegboard-backed cardboard display sits squarely within our established range and was publicly presented, accumulated development and marketing commitment make continued backing more likely than withdrawal.

This eighth-pallet cardboard display is a straightforward extension of the core assortment, so management would be inclined to justify the prior launch and retain it as part of a narrow strategic range.

Although its media focus makes it somewhat more vulnerable, it still builds directly on our core quarter-pallet display business, and sunk costs plus a tendency to attribute weaker results to market-specific conditions favor keeping it for now.
